name: Find your inspiration
title: Your home. Your point of view.
description: Before deciding how a room should look, think about how you live in it. Films together, quiet reading or friends staying late. Let the arrangement make room for those moments.

section-1.title: Start with the bigger picture.
section-1.body: Before deciding how a room should look, think about how you live in it. Films together, quiet reading or friends staying late. Let the arrangement make room for those moments.

section-2.title: Think in colours and textures.
section-2.body: Choose a starting tone and add depth through texture. Warm wood, a fabric surface and daylight can change how a colour feels. Leave room for those differences when bringing your favourite pieces together.

section-3.title: A little space makes a difference.
section-3.body: You do not have to fill every corner. Clear paths between seats and an open space by the window help a room breathe.
